recentItems.title: Weird But True! Full Episode Compilation | Science Rules 🧠 | Nat Geo Kids
recentItems.description:
Watch this compilation of three Weird But True episodes on Nat Geo Kids YouTube!

00:00:00 Egg Drop Challenge
The sibling rivalry is at an all time high this week at the Engelman house. Casey, the gold star sister, holds the school record for the egg drop challenge. Determined to beat her older sister and go down in engineering history, Kirby must master the scientific method! But it wont be easy, so they head to Penn State University to learn from the best in the biz.

00:22:00 Volcano Science Fair
Everyone knows if you want to win your school's science fair you have to WOW the Judges. Determined to win this year’s science fair, Charlie and Kirby turn to the classic -- Erupting Volcano. With their eyes on the prize, the sibling duo will travel to Hawaii to uncover the secrets of volcanoes and learn some Weird but True facts along the way!

00:44:00 Master Crafters
Kirby heads to a Crafty Campers Animation and Technology Expo to learn all about the new advancements in crafting technology. But Charlie despises technology! All it does is separate us! Blindsided by Kirby’s “betrayal”, Charlie heads to Colonial Williamsburg to discover how crafting was done in the good ol’ days…before technology RUINED EVERYTHING!

recentItems.title: Jack Hanna's Passport Full Episode | Colors of the World 🌎 | Nat Geo Kids
recentItems.description:
Watch this full episode of Jack Hanna's Passport, "Colors of the World", on Nat Geo Kids YouTube! The Hannas are on a quest to see the most colorful creatures on the planet. They track rare white lions in a South African desert, learn the difference between brown and black bears in Canada, and travel to Rwanda to discover how golden monkeys live in a bamboo forest. Later, Jack joins vibrant hummingbirds in a cloud forest for a taste of nectar.

recentItems.title: Exploring a Hidden Ghost City! 👻 | Lost Cities with Albert Lin | Nat Geo Kids
recentItems.description:
Watch this full episode of Lost Cities with Albert Lin, "Ghost City of the Pacific", on Nat Geo Kids YouTube! National Geographic Explorer and scientist Albert Lin travels to Micronesia, in the heart of the Pacific Ocean, to uncover the ancient island city of Nan Madol. Exploring the tombs, temples and ritual sites, all built on man-made islands now shrouded by centuries of jungle growth, Lin discovers not just a city but an entire ocean continent spanning thousands of miles.
